architecture.mechanism: Data acquisition and processing for digital modeling to identify hidden faults causing no-load overheating.
architecture.intervention: Implement a digital twin system with high-frequency current and vibration sensors to create a real-time thermal model of the motor, comparing simulated no-load losses against actual measurements to isolate anomalies like inter-turn shorts or air-gap eccentricity.
architecture.expected_effect: Precise identification of the specific internal fault causing excessive iron or stray load losses despite balanced resistance, enabling targeted repair before thermal overload trips.
architecture.falsification_test: If the digital twin model, calibrated with measured supply voltage and winding resistance, predicts normal no-load temperature rise while the physical motor still overheats, the mechanism of using digital twins for this specific fault diagnosis is invalid for this case.
